_meta.title: Synthesis-as-binding-constraint: four cross-field imports + closed-form winner's curse
_meta.substrate: gpt52 single-judge unless noted; pure CPU on df_*.parquet + canonical_numbers.json

evt.cross_field_import: Extreme-value theory / winner's curse (Gumbel/BLUE order statistics)
evt.caveats: sigma_run is the gpt52 single-judge run SD (matched to routability.raw single-judge substrate). The Gumbel/exact closed form is E[max]-mean under the EXCHANGEABLE null (all 11 arms equal true quality); it is an UPPER bound on the winner's curse and does NOT credit genuine arch x query signal. The data-driven bootstrap (which keeps real signal) attributes 24.7%% to noise; the closed form shows the SCALE of the winner's-curse risk is comparable to the whole raw effect. The 3-judge panel headroom (0.0561) is even smaller, consistent with a less noisy substrate.
evt.verdict: Pure per-query run-selection noise (sigma_run=0.0591, N=11) manufactures a Gumbel E[max]-mean headroom of 0.0834 (exact order-stat 0.0937), i.e. 88%-99% of the raw oracle headroom (0.0945). The raw oracle 'routability' number is on the same scale as a pure selection artefact; the winner's-curse-corrected bootstrap keeps 75% (0.0712), and the realisable router still fails to beat best-fixed.

oring.cross_field_import: Kremer (1993) O-ring production function (multiplicative stage complementarity)
oring.binding_constraint_after_intervention: utilisation / synthesis-of-sources (retrieval-availability falsified by E5 gold injection; E14 utilisation ceiling 0.32). The low retrieval-labelled stage is a downstream synthesis (grounding/recall) bottleneck, not a source-availability one.
oring.passive_fit_caveat: Y=overall_score is a weighted SUM of the nine dimensions, so the additive model has a mechanical advantage and the interaction coefficients are ~0 by construction. The passive fit therefore CANNOT falsify O-ring complementarity; use the intervention test.

oring_intervention_prediction.note: Both PASSIVE-fit models extrapolate a large gain from perfect retrieval (additive 0.346, multiplicative fitted 0.129) because they are confounded by Y being a weighted sum. The CAUSAL intervention (E5) shows ~0 factual gain and E14 caps utilisation at 0.32: perfect retrieval does not rescue quality because source-utilisation (a synthesis capability) is binding. The gap between the passive prediction and the null intervention IS the O-ring result.

oring.verdict: REFINED (honest): the NOMINAL min stage is retrieval=0.319 (synthesis=0.543, citation=0.411), driven by low information_recall (0.179) and factual_accuracy (0.300). But the O-ring INTERVENTION falsifies retrieval-AVAILABILITY as the binding input: injecting perfect retrieval (E5 gold q_ret->1) gives a factual slope of -0.0011 (CI [-0.03500797211962474, 0.03278574989740243] includes 0), a g100-g000 factual change of -0.0028, and E14 caps source-utilisation at 0.32<<1 with only 0.092 of the factual channel attributable to retrieval availability. So the low retrieval-stage score is a UTILISATION (synthesis-of-sources) bottleneck, not a retrieval-availability one. Raising the nominal min stage's INPUT yields ~0 gain because the binding factor is the downstream synthesis/utilisation capability -- the Kremer O-ring signature (a low, hard-to-improve factor caps the product). Passive additive-vs-multiplicative fit is CONFOUNDED (Y is a weighted SUM of the same dims: R2_add=0.975 > R2_mult=0.947) and is NOT decisive.

amdahl.cross_field_import: Amdahl's Law (serial-fraction bound on parallel speedup)
amdahl.axis: compute dose (cost_proxy_usd relative to P0) holding retrieval-agent family
amdahl.caveats: Small-N fit (4 dose points); quality-as-throughput is a heuristic mapping. Two of the points (matched_P1, full P1) hold the architecture fixed and vary only budget, giving a genuine compute-dose contrast; P0 and P4 anchor the ends.
amdahl.verdict: On the compute-dose ladder (P0 1x -> matched_P1 3.2x -> P1 12.1x -> P4 17.5x), quality rises only 0.427 -> 0.495. Amdahl fit: parallelisable fraction f=0.124, so the SERIAL (non-parallelisable) fraction is 0.876 (~88%). Asymptotic quality at infinite compute is 0.488, which still falls 0.076 short of the per-query oracle ceiling (0.564): scaling parallel compute alone cannot reach what architecture selection achieves. Returns to orchestration compute are dominated by a large serial bottleneck.

nk.cross_field_import: NK fitness landscape / global epistasis (sum-of-marginals vs total)
nk.convention: single-component contribution = base - ablated = -ablation_delta; full_minus_baseline_gap uses the plain P0 pipeline as the all-components-off null; shortfall = sum_single - gap (>0 => sub-additive / substitutable components).
nk.verdict: Sum of single-component contributions vastly exceeds the net architecture advantage over the plain P0 baseline: P4 sum=0.126 vs full-minus-P0 gap=0.085 (shortfall 0.041, 1.5x); P5 sum=0.070 vs gap=0.043 (shortfall 0.027). Large positive shortfall = strong NEGATIVE / diminishing epistasis: components substitute rather than stack. The single load-bearing component is p4:no_triangulation (drop 0.0599). Orchestration components are individually necessary but jointly redundant -- consistent with one shared binding bottleneck (synthesis).

triangulation_note: AGREEMENT: three independent cross-field lenses converge on ONE shared, non-parallelisable, sub-additive binding constraint, localised to synthesis/utilisation. (O-ring) the nominal min stage is retrieval-labelled (0.319), but the E5 intervention falsifies retrieval-AVAILABILITY as the fixable input (factual slope ~0, utilisation ceiling 0.32) -- the true binding factor is downstream synthesis-of-sources (grounding/recall), and raising a non-binding input caps the product exactly as Kremer predicts. (Amdahl) the serial non-parallelisable fraction of orchestration compute is 0.88, asymptote 0.488, still 0.076 short of the oracle ceiling -- parallel compute cannot buy the bottleneck away. (NK) single-component contributions sum to 0.126 but the net P4-over-P0 advantage is only 0.085 (shortfall 0.041): components substitute, not stack, consistent with all of them pushing on the SAME shared factor. Separately, the EVT closed form shows 88-99% of the raw oracle 'routability' headroom is a pure winner's-curse selection artefact. All four imports point the same way: orchestration returns are bounded because architectures contend for a single shared, serial, hard-to-improve synthesis/utilisation bottleneck -- not because any one component or more compute or better retrieval is missing. HONEST CAVEAT: the O-ring stage LABELS put factual grounding under 'retrieval'; the synthesis localisation rests on the E5/E14 utilisation evidence, not on stage quality alone.
